notes.title: Happy (Late) Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
Hello survivors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36598840/8df908846719871d6c70264a2328a2e9b097d82c.png[/img]

We had a small update planned for Halloween. We missed our deadline by exactly one day, but we thought we'd still upload it and allow you all to celebrate the Spooky Holiday once again.

This update adds a brand new secret epilogue to the game! In order to see it, you need to complete the game on any difficulty and save [i]both[/i] non-player characters. Going forward, this variation of the ending is the canon version and will lead into [i]Derange 2[/i]. It also connects the game to the [i]One Night[/i] series, Dark Gaia's previous horror franchise.

We've also tinkered with the Steam achievements. Any instances of them not triggering should now be fixed.

Update #2 now available!
notes.notes:
Hello survivors.

The second major update for Derange is now live on Steam. This update includes some further minor tweaks to combat and gameplay mechanics, as well as fixes for issues identified by the community.

The update includes the following changes:

[list][*] Taking damage from an enemy now makes you immune to further attacks for 60 frames, giving you some time to try and escape if you've been cornered.
[*] The damage and HP values of some enemies have been slightly tweaked on different Hive Mind AI levels.
[*] The Hive Mind AI has been slightly tweaked so that it will not flip rapidly between modes as often.
[*] A rare bug that would make Jessica's sprite invisible when finishing the prologue has been fixed.
[*] The cutscene with Marcus outside of the Art Gallery will no longer lock your character's facing to a single direction.
[*] A bugged variation of the clock puzzle has been fixed.
[*] Some doors and item pickups that were not functioning correctly have been fixed.[/list]

We are also aware that Steam achievements may not be properly triggering for some players. We are looking into this and will address it in a future update.

notes.title: Update #1 now available!
notes.notes:
Hello survivors.

The first update for Derange is now live on Steam. This update includes some minor tweaks to the combat system (laying the foundation for more comprehensive changes further down the line) and some fixes to bugs and issues identified by the community. 

The update includes the following changes:
[list]
[*]The timing window for pressing the attack button has been increased. You can now press the button at any point while the "!" prompt is on screen to successfully trigger your attack.
[*]The Baseball Bat now has a hit chance of 100%. This is intended to make melee combat a viable option for dispatching enemies, if still inferior to gunplay. The Knife and Meat Cleaver remain unchanged at 50%.
[*]You can now reload a gun without having to wait for it to run out of bullets first. Be careful though - any bullets left in the old magazine will be permanently lost!
[*]An issue which would prevent the entry of an employee's name in the Archive Room has been fixed.
[*]A rare crash which would occur when playing certain sound files has been fixed.
[/list]
